cards.title: Cognition Targets $40B Valuation in New Fundraise
cards.body: The AI coding startup is reportedly in talks to raise another mega round just months after securing $1 billion at a $26 billion valuation. The potential new round would significantly increase the company's valuation.

cards.title: AI Pioneers Debate Regulation and Open-Source Access
cards.body: Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng discussed AI safety, regulation, and competitive dynamics at Ai4. The debate centered on how America can compete as China advances in AI.

cards.title: OpenAI-Backed Thrive Holdings Raises $2B
cards.body: Thrive Holdings secured $2 billion in funding at a $12 billion valuation from major investors including SoftBank and D1 Capital Partners. The funding will support bringing AI solutions to enterprise customers.

cards.title: Automattic's Mesh CRM Comes to Android
cards.body: Mesh, an AI-powered contacts and relationship management app from Automattic, is now available on Android. The app helps users organize and manage their professional relationships.

cards.title: Sandbar Focuses on Voice-First AI Wearables
cards.body: The company behind Stream's ring is positioning voice as the future of AI wearables, joining a wave of notetaking hardware devices. Sandbar aims to capture meetings and generate summaries through voice-enabled rings.

cards.title: Lovable Hits $13.3B Valuation, Raises $400M
cards.body: Lovable raised an additional $400 million at a $13.3 billion valuation following strong revenue growth. The startup achieved $500 million in annualized run rate revenue in June.

cards.title: $250M Acquisition Collapses Into Fraud Allegations
cards.body: VideoVerse's $250 million acquisition deal has collapsed amid allegations of fraud and forged signatures. Co-founder Vinayak Shrivastav is now facing multiple legal cases, leaving investors waiting for their share.

cards.title: Sandbar's Voice Ring Targets AI Hardware Success
cards.body: Sandbar's voice-enabled ring aims to succeed where other AI notetaking hardware has struggled. The device promises to capture meetings and generate summaries through natural voice interaction.

cards.title: Google Announces Pixel 11, Watch 5, and Gemini
cards.body: Google's Made by Google '26 event unveiled the Pixel 11 series, Pixel Watch 5, and new Pixel Tag device. The announcements also featured extensive new Gemini AI features across products.

cards.title: Blacksmith's Valuation Jumps 10x in One Year
cards.body: The AI code-testing startup's valuation skyrocketed as revenue grew more than tenfold over the past year. Blacksmith continues to demonstrate strong growth in the AI testing market.

cards.title: Accel Closes $550M India Fund in Record Time
cards.body: The U.S. VC firm closed its oversubscribed $550 million India fund within weeks, just 19 months after its previous fund. Accel still has over 55% of its previous $650 million fund available.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Desktop App for Linux
cards.body: OpenAI is finally bringing a dedicated ChatGPT desktop application to Linux operating systems. The move expands accessibility for Linux users seeking native ChatGPT integration.

cards.title: Google's Gemini Surges to 1 Billion Users
cards.body: Google announced that Gemini has reached 1 billion users, with 63% using the voice feature. The chatbot now generates more than 150 million images daily.

cards.title: OpenAI COO Brad Lightcap Exits Company
cards.body: Brad Lightcap, one of OpenAI's longest-serving executives and longtime COO, is leaving the company. Lightcap told staff he was excited to help advance the mission from a different vantage point.

cards.title: General Catalyst Leads $1.1B Round Into River AI
cards.body: River AI, founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin, secured $1.1 billion in funding led by General Catalyst. The 2-month-old startup has a vision for building advanced personal AI agents.

cards.title: Anthropic Model Makes Progress on Riemann Hypothesis
cards.body: An unreleased Anthropic model made meaningful progress on the Riemann hypothesis, a major unsolved math problem for 150+ years. While not solving it, the model demonstrated unexpected capability on difficult mathematical problems.

cards.title: Spotify Labels AI-Generated Artist Personas
cards.body: Spotify is introducing 'AI Persona' labels for artist profiles representing AI-generated identities. The platform will exclude AI-generated music from editorial, algorithmic, and personalized recommendations by default.

cards.title: Anthropic Will Watermark AI-Generated Text
cards.body: Anthropic announced plans to watermark text generated by its AI models to identify AI content. The company will extend watermarking support to older models as well.

cards.title: OpenAI Completes $7B Employee Tender Offer
cards.body: OpenAI reportedly completed a $7 billion employee tender offer, allowing staff to sell shares. The offer reflects the company's significant valuation growth.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches New Cyber Defense AI Model
cards.body: OpenAI is expanding its Daybreak cybersecurity defense program and rolling out a new cyber-trained AI model. The expansion addresses the growing threat of AI-led cyberattacks.

cards.title: Scaling AI agents requires trustworthy data
cards.body: Organizations rapidly adopting AI agents face challenges in achieving ROI without reliable data foundations. Business leaders must prioritize data quality for agentic AI success.

cards.title: AI professors negotiate new research realities
cards.body: AI academics are adapting to changing dynamics in research, funding, and competition from industry. The landscape for AI academic research is shifting significantly.

cards.title: AI for science needs reasoning over data
cards.body: AI agents for scientific discovery require strong reasoning capabilities beyond data processing. Eric Schmidt and others argue reasoning is key to AI's scientific potential.

cards.title: Startups chase next breakthrough in LLMs
cards.body: Following the transformer's introduction nine years ago, new startups are exploring the next evolution in large language models. The LLM landscape continues rapid innovation.

cards.title: Gemini becomes Google's fastest-growing product
cards.body: Google's Gemini AI chatbot hit 1 billion users faster than any previous Google product. The milestone highlights rapid AI adoption among consumers.
